description: Allowed high-level MCP tools the dog agent may invoke. These are declarative behavior requests; the game resolves them into existing tasks, sequences, or decision modules.
criticalRules: Use only tool names listed in this catalog.
Do not invent tools or arguments that are not listed here.
Prefer concrete object-grounded actions using target_id over vague spatial descriptions.
For object-based tools, target_id must exactly match a known object or entity id from the prompt context.
reasoning should be a short single-line explanation of why the tool was chosen, for later history and continuity.
Use persistent mode tools only when the intent is ongoing behavior until replaced or stopped.
Do not output engine-level or direct-control commands such as transforms, coordinates, teleporting, health changes, or inventory mutation outside the listed tools.
If uncertain and no better grounded action is available, prefer wait, sniff, examine_object, or start_exploring depending on context.

mcpConvention: In MCP, the tool name identifies the action.
Arguments should include only the fields listed in that tool's inputSchema.
The game may apply default execution settings such as interruption behavior, stack behavior, and source tagging.
notes.planResponseV3Mapping: Each MCP tool name corresponds directly to the PlanResponseV3 action name of the same string.

tools.name: bark
tools.description: Make a bark with a social or tactical intent. Optionally include a target if the bark is about a specific object or entity.

tools.name: emote
tools.description: Display a visible body-language emotion or social signal without barking. Use this for posture, tail, ears, playfulness, fear, submission, or excitement.

tools.name: set_walk_mode
tools.description: Change style of walking.

tools.name: face_object
tools.description: Turn to face a target.

persistence.description: If true, remain facing the target while performing follow-up actions until stopped or replaced.

tools.name: move_to_object
tools.description: Move to target.

tools.name: examine_object
tools.description: Move to target and examine by looking, sniffing, and listening to target.

tools.name: sniff
tools.description: Sniff the ground and air at the current location.

tools.name: take_object
tools.description: Move to target and pick it up in mouth. Carrying is limited to one object at a time, of an appropriate size.

tools.name: drop_object
tools.description: Drop currently held object.

tools.name: bury_object
tools.description: Dig a hole and bury currently held object.

tools.name: dig
tools.description: Dig a hole. If an object is found, pick it up in your mouth.

tools.name: go_through_door
tools.description: Move to target door, open it if necessary, go through to the other side, and examine what is there.

tools.name: open_door
tools.description: Move to target door and open it. Examine what is on the other side.

tools.name: close_door
tools.description: Move to target door and close it.

tools.name: interact_with_object
tools.description: Move to target object and manipulate it in a relevant way, such as open, close, push, pull, or scratch. Not for doors.

tools.name: interact_with_held_object
tools.description: Do something with the item currently carried in your mouth, such as drop, bury, eat, chew, or destroy.

tools.name: join_pack
tools.description: Become a member of the target's pack.

tools.name: become_pack_leader
tools.description: Become the leader of your current pack.

tools.name: leave_pack
tools.description: Leave your current pack.

tools.name: start_exploring
tools.description: Begin wandering the area, exploring new rooms and objects encountered. Continues until replaced or stopped.

tools.name: start_follow_pack_leader
tools.description: Begin following the current pack leader. Continues until replaced or stopped.

tools.name: start_follow_on_leash
tools.description: Begin following the leash holder, trying to stay close enough not to pull back on the leash. Continues until replaced or stopped.

tools.name: start_follow_object
tools.description: Begin following the target, trying to stay at a distance. Continues until replaced or stopped.

tools.name: start_follow_scent
tools.description: Begin searching for the source of a scent target. Follow the strongest scent, searching around scent pools to pick up the trail again.

tools.name: start_patrol_room
tools.description: Begin circling the current room watching for intruders. Continues until replaced or stopped.

tools.name: start_patrol_around_object
tools.description: Begin circling the target object watching for intruders. Continues until replaced or stopped.

tools.name: start_stay
tools.description: Stay in place until stopped or a reaction stronger than training breaks the stay.

tools.name: stop_current_mode
tools.description: Stop any continuous command such as explore, follow, patrol, stay, or persistent facing.

tools.name: nap
tools.description: Lay down, close eyes, and rest for the specified duration in seconds.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Do nothing for the specified duration in seconds.
